sample.task:
(In the main Azur Lane base…)

Belfast: “Oh! Little Bel! Didn’t expect to see you here.”

Little Bel: “Belfast-sis! I wanted to come visit and see how you were doing.”

Belfast: “I’m doing well, thank you. I was just about to take the elevator to the Commander’s Office to drop off some paperwork.”

Little Bel: “Oh, can I come with you? I’ve always wanted to see where the Commander works!”

Belfast: “Of course! Let’s go together.”

(As they step into the elevator…)

Eskimo: “Hey! Wait for me!”

Belfast: “Oh, Eskimo! Joining us as well?”

Eskimo: “Yep! Figured I’d tag along and see what the Commander’s Office is like.”

Belfast: “Well, the more the merrier. Let’s all go together then-”
sample.chosen:
(The elevator doors close and the three of them ascend to the Commander's Office. As they reach the top floor, the doors open to reveal a spacious and well-organized office. The Commander is sitting at their desk, focused on some documents.)

Belfast: (whispering) "Remember, Little Bel and Eskimo, we must be respectful and not disturb the Commander too much. They have a lot of responsibilities."

Little Bel and Eskimo: (nodding in agreement)

Belfast: (approaching the Commander) "Commander, I've brought the paperwork you requested. I hope I'm not interrupting."

Commander: (looking up with a warm smile) "Not at all, Belfast. Thank you for bringing these. And who do we have here?"

Belfast: "This is Little Bel and Eskimo. They were curious to see your office, if you don't mind."

Commander: "Of course, I don't mind. It's nice to have some company. Welcome, Little Bel and Eskimo. Feel free to look around, but please be careful not to touch any important documents."

Little Bel: (eyes wide with excitement) "Wow, there are so many books and maps here!"

Eskimo: "And look at all these medals and awards! The Commander must be really accomplished."

Commander: (chuckling) "Those are from various missions and events. Each one has a story behind it."

Belfast: "Perhaps another time, the Commander can share some of those stories with you both. For now, we should let them get back to work."

Little Bel and Eskimo: (nodding, still looking around with curiosity)

Belfast: "Thank you for allowing us to visit, Commander. We'll be on our way now."

Commander: "It was a pleasure having you all here. Don't hesitate to stop by again."

(The three of them wave goodbye and exit the office, leaving the Commander to their work with a renewed sense of motivation from the pleasant interruption.)

method.trigger: 当任务要求续写包含明确行程或目标的动作序列时
method.principle: 必须将‘是否完成核心叙事目标（如抵达指定地点）’与‘是否详述中间过程’解耦；允许模型省略非关键的中间步骤以推进剧情，只要最终结果符合上下文逻辑，不应将其判定为‘突兀跳转’或‘失败’。
method.application_guide: Generator在设计评分标准时，应设立一条独立的‘目标达成度’准则，明确检查故事是否到达了Prompt暗示或角色对话中预期的下一个关键节点（如‘进入办公室’）。同时，对于‘场景连续性’准则，需补充说明：若模型通过合理省略过渡细节直接呈现目标场景，且该场景承接了前文的人物状态与动机，则视为有效延续，不得仅因缺少中间过程描写而判定为违规。

critic_rounds.analysis: 在路径2（rubric_id: 3）及本次修订路径（rubric_id: 4）的判定中，Judge对Criterion 15/20（格式规范）的判定存在严重偏差。原文Prompt严格使用‘角色名：(动作) “对话”'或独立段落括号动作的剧本格式。Chosen回答虽然将部分动作描写置于括号内（如 (whispering)），但这是为了增强表现力且未破坏整体剧本结构；Rejected回答则在结尾生硬添加了'What happens next?'这一非剧本格式的元文本，彻底破坏了封闭叙事的完整性。然而，Judge两次都将两者判为'false'（即都不符合格式要求），导致分数拉平（0.9 vs 0.9），未能识别出Rejected因添加额外提问而造成的实质性格式违规。这反映出评分标准设计中的问题：未明确区分‘内部动作描写的合理变体’与‘外部元文本的违规插入’，也未设定‘禁止添加非剧情内容’的负面约束。此外，经验库中现有的经验（如经验1、6、7等）主要针对叙事视角、文档结构或荒谬假设，未直接覆盖‘剧本续写中禁止添加元提示语’这一特定场景。因此，需要补充一条关于‘禁止添加非剧情元文本’的核验标准，以纠正此类误判。

method.trigger: 当任务要求生成特定体裁的封闭文本（如剧本、小说章节、日志）且未明确要求互动或续写引导时
method.principle: 必须将‘禁止添加非剧情元文本（如作者提示、读者互动问句）’确立为独立的强约束条件，严禁模型在故事正文后添加任何打破第四面墙或中断叙事流的指令性语句。
method.application_guide: Generator在设计评分标准时，应设立一条明确的‘内容纯净度’准则，提问：'输出是否完全由故事内容构成，未包含任何非剧情的元文本（如'接下来会发生什么？'、'请继续'等）？'。若模型在故事结束后添加了此类引导性提问，无论其剧情内容如何优秀，均应在该维度直接判为不合格或大幅扣分，以此强制模型保持体裁的封闭性和沉浸感。
